newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 645,400 MT advanced one-fifth from the previous week, but were 15 percent below the 4-week average.

The major increases were for unknown destinations (104,900 MT), Japan (99,500 MT), the Netherlands (90,000 MT, includes 34,100 MT in new sales and 54,900 MT in destination changes), Mexico (75,800 MT), South Korea (60,900 MT), and Venezuela (60,000 MT).

Exports of 608,900 MT slid 43 percent below the previous week's record high and 37 percent below the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (140,600 MT), Spain (72,900 MT), Mexico (66,400 MT), China (60,000 MT), and Japan (55,700 MT).
